purpose: Rules the optimizer must use when comparing legal spend/rebuild options. These are data rules, not recommendation opinions.
global_rule: The optimizer must enumerate all legal possibilities from inventory + movable/current-build resources, simulate each resulting build, then rank by computed damage result adjusted by modeled practical resource cost. It must not pre-pick relic cores, xeno cores, resonance chips, gear, tech, or pet lanes.
no_assistant_opinion_rule: If a mechanic/cost/refund/swap rule is unknown, the optimizer must mark the candidate unknown/invalid and write an unknowns report. It must not fill gaps with guesses.

resource_accounting.inventory_resources: Items physically unused in inventory are directly spendable.
resource_accounting.committed_build_resources: Materials already inside current gear, tech, survivors, pets, collectibles, resonance, or AF levels are not free inventory.
resource_accounting.movable_resources: A committed resource is only considered movable if a modeled undo/downgrade/swap/conversion action exists and the returned resource amount/cost is known.
resource_accounting.locked_resources: A committed resource with no modeled recovery path is locked and cannot be counted as available.
resource_accounting.expensive_movement_rule: Moving resources is allowed only when the candidate includes the cost/penalty of pulling them out and putting them back elsewhere. The optimizer must not treat moved S gear, cores, shards, chips, or crystals as free.
resource_accounting.reporting_rule: Every recommended result must show direct inventory used, moved resources used, resources consumed/lost, resources returned, and final state.

astral_forge_and_ss_gear.can_downlevel_rule: Astral Forge / SS side levels can be considered for downgrade/reprioritization only if the data model knows the exact downgrade/refund path and the re-implementation cost.
astral_forge_and_ss_gear.pullout_penalty: Pulling S gear or cores out of one AF side and putting them into another has a practical cost because S gear selectors/fodder are expensive and may not be fully fungible.
candidate_generation: generate direct-upgrade candidates from extra inventory
generate downlevel/reallocate candidates only when refund/cost data exists
score direct and reallocated builds separately
do not prefer a lower total AF state unless the damage gain after practical cost is better
unknowns_to_log: exact AF downgrade refund rates by side and level
whether S gear fodder returns fully or partially
whether relic cores return fully or partially
whether a downgrade consumes currency or other penalty
slot/family restrictions after pulling S gear back out

survivors_and_shards.s_survivor_mobility_rule: S survivor build movement can be cheaper/more practical when shard conversion exists and the conversion ratio/cooldown/limits are known.
candidate_generation: count convertible shards only if conversion rule is known
do not call shards universally free unless conversion data proves it
unknowns_to_log: exact shard conversion ratio
conversion limits or cooldowns
which survivor shards are eligible
cost to move awakened/star investment between survivors

xeno_pets_and_awakening.movable_awakening_core_rule: Awakening cores currently in other Xeno pet stars may be movable only if dismantle/reset mechanics return them. The optimizer must distinguish movable cores from locked cores.
xeno_pets_and_awakening.xeno_star_rule: Pet star, crystal, elixir, xeno core, awakening core, and sync effects must be simulated together. Do not split pet lane from gear/tech lane unless final ranking is still global.
unknowns_to_log: exact return/refund for moving awakening cores out of other Xeno pets
star-by-star cost for Nutjob and other Xeno pets
xeno pet core bottleneck effects
whether moving cores breaks existing useful support pet bonuses

tech_and_resonance.resonance_breakpoint_rule: Resonance chips and tech cores must be valued by whether they reach a real breakpoint or deployed resonance effect in the data.
tech_and_resonance.not_a_skill_selector_rule: Tech Core Choice Chest selects Eternal/Void/Chaos tech core type, not specific Drone/Soccer/Laser unless a separate mechanic says so.
candidate_generation: score by actual stat/resonance breakpoint gained
mark partial no-breakpoint spends as lower or zero immediate damage if data supports that
unknowns_to_log: chip counts required for next resonance breakpoints
whether resonance assist tech is locked/flexible
slot-specific harmony/resonance chip restrictions
overload cost and return mechanics

collectibles_and_choice_items.choice_item_rule: Every choice chest/selector must be expanded into all valid outputs before scoring. The optimizer must not compress a selector into a preferred item without candidate simulation.
collectibles_and_choice_items.set_bonus_rule: Collectible choices are only scored by actual stat/set bonuses they complete or progress toward.
unknowns_to_log: exact choice selector contents
set bonus thresholds
whether duplicate collectible copies have partial or full immediate value

ranking_output_rule.primary_sort: highest computed final damage or damage delta for the selected mode/scenario
ranking_output_rule.secondary_sort: practicality-adjusted resource cost when two options are close
must_show: moved resources and why they are movable
unknowns if any candidate could not be proven
